title_candidates: Datasette Agent gets safer write actions with approval prompts
summary: Datasette Agent 0.3a0 adds approval-gated database writes, a useful pattern for anyone letting AI touch real data instead of just reading it.

primary_source.title: datasette-agent 0.3a0
primary_source.author: Simon Willison
key_facts: Datasette Agent 0.3a0 is a pre-release from June 15, 2026.
The release adds an execute_write_sql tool that requests user approval before writing to a database and respects Datasette permissions.
The chat command can now execute tools that require user approval.
The project README describes Datasette Agent as an LLM-powered assistant for Datasette with permissions for chat, exploration, and background agents.

prerequisites: A Datasette project or a sample SQLite database
An LLM provider configured for Datasette

steps.instruction: Open the datasette-agent README and confirm the plugin fits your Datasette setup.
Install or update the plugin in a non-production Datasette environment first.
Open the agent interface and ask it to inspect a small test table before allowing any write action.
When a write approval prompt appears, read the proposed SQL, database, and permission context before approving.
Keep write-capable testing on sample data until you are comfortable with the approval flow.

risk_flags: This is a developer-facing tool, so the guide limits itself to users who already run Datasette.
